articles.title: Wall Street and crypto are crashing into each other as tokenized treasury markets hit $14.6 billion
articles.snippet: Not all crypto exchange executives agree, but the data does not lie: centralized exchange trading volumes dropped more than 11% to $4.61 trillion, their lowest since late 2024.

articles.title: Crypto should adopt the best of centralization, says LMAX CEO
articles.snippet: As digital assets mature the industry should borrow more from traditional market infrastructure, especially credit, clearing and collateral systems, David Mercer argues.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies above $63,000 as its worst week in months got a late macro rescue
articles.snippet: A tiny Strategy sale raised a bigger question about Saylor’s never-sell stance, while easing Iran fears, and a strong SpaceX debut helped risk assets recover.

articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX soars 20% in blockbuster Nasdaq debut
articles.snippet: The stock was trading above $160 in volatile action after last night's IPO at $135.

articles.title: Trump says Iran peace deal to be signed Sunday, contradicting Tehran
articles.snippet: Crypto analyst Michaël van de Poppe said a peace deal, which would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, would likely send liquidity back to risk-on assets such as cryptocurrencies.
